title: Household Energy Use by Appliance: A Pie Chart Summary
prompt: The pie chart below shows the percentage breakdown of household electricity consumption by appliance category in a typical four-person home in the country of Valdoria in 2023. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为学术类 Task 1 模拟练习，图中所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试题。写作时请注意：先整体观察饼图各扇区占比，找出占比最大与最小的类别，再对相近数值进行分组比较；用概述句点明主要特征，不要逐项罗列数字，也不要给出个人观点或解释原因；合理使用比例、比较和排序的表达，并确保达到 150 词以上。
